behavior: Generic immutable persistence treats caller batches as untrusted and canonically rebuilds whitelisted table/column contracts, identities, identity digests, row digests, operation count, SQL plans and batch hash before any database prepare or transport.
Only regenerated INSERT statements can reach the isolated System2 D1 writer.
Every inserted immutable row receives exact post-write readback; divergent concurrent/post-write state fails closed.
A measured statement ledger records select/insert counts, batch transports, verified inserted rows, reported changes and statement hashes.
Decision persistence verifies factor/regime parent existence and matching date/clock/symbol lineage.
Decision corrections are append-only in s2_decision_corrections and require an existing original decision.
Outcome persistence independently rebuilds SQL/digests and verifies order-to-decision, fill-to-order and outcome-to-decision lineage.
AP-08 caller UPDATE-as-insert is rejected before db.batch.
